title: Incorporate C-Corp
description: Set up a new Delaware C-Corporation with standard startup structure including bylaws, stock purchase agreements, and initial board resolutions.

functionCalls.description: Must be mailed within 30 days of stock purchase

title: Get EIN
description: Apply for an Employer Identification Number (EIN) from the IRS for the newly incorporated company.
supportReason: IRS EIN application is a web form with no API. System provides step-by-step guidance and pre-fills company data.

functionCalls.description: Pull company details for form pre-fill

title: Register state taxes
description: Register for state income tax, sales tax, and employment tax in operating states.
supportReason: State tax portals have no APIs. System provides state-specific checklists and pre-fills company data.

title: Raise pre-seed (SAFEs)
description: Execute a pre-seed fundraise using Y Combinator SAFE notes, including document preparation, investor outreach, and closing.
supportReason: System can draft SAFEs, track investor pipeline, send follow-ups, and manage documents. Negotiations and meetings are person-routed.

functionCalls.description: File Form D within 15 days of first sale

title: 409A valuation

supportReason: Carta API can record grants. Board consent and option agreements need human review. System drafts materials and tracks.

title: Send NDA

supportReason: System generates NDA from template, populates company data, and sends via DocuSign API. Fully automatable with approval gate.

title: File trademark
description: File a trademark application with the USPTO for the company name and/or logo.
supportReason: USPTO has no usable API. System provides guidance, drafts descriptions, and tracks deadlines, but filing is manual.

title: IP assignments

supportReason: System generates PIIAs from templates, tracks who has signed, sends via DocuSign. Legal review is person-routed.

supportReason: System can draft initial templates using company context. Legal review and customer-specific negotiations are person-routed.

title: File DE franchise tax
description: File the annual Delaware franchise tax and annual report.
supportReason: Delaware franchise tax portal has no API. System calculates the tax, pre-fills data, provides step-by-step guidance.

title: File federal tax return
description: Prepare the annual federal corporate tax return (Form 1120) and file with the IRS.
supportReason: Tax filing requires a CPA. System compiles financial data, tracks deadlines, coordinates with accountant.

title: Issue 1099s
description: Generate and file 1099-NEC forms for all contractors paid over $600 in the tax year.
supportReason: Gusto can auto-generate 1099s for contractors on their platform. System compiles data and tracks filing deadlines.

supportReason: Insurance quoting platforms lack APIs. System guides through requirements, compiles company data, tracks quotes.

supportReason: Vanta API supports test monitoring and evidence collection. Policy creation and auditor engagement need human input.

supportReason: Core platform capability via tasks.list() with user filter.

functionCalls.description: List tasks assigned to current user

description: Coworker chat suggestion: "Goal progress this week." Agent retrieves active goals with deadlines in the current week.
supportReason: Goals are a core platform object queried via goals.list().

supportReason: Derived from integrations.list() and tools metadata.

supportReason: Stripe is a sandbox integration with comprehensive API for payments, subscriptions, and invoices.

supportReason: Bank account opening requires manual application. Platform guides vendor selection.
